import hashlib,json,math
from pathlib import Path
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
e=json.loads(Path('/tmp/input/expected.json').read_text());r=e['receipt'];assert sha('/experiment/research/detector-optimizer-resource-verified.json')==e['receipt_sha256']
for p,h in r['candidate_hashes'].items():assert sha(Path('/experiment')/p)==h
for p,h in r['artifacts'].items():assert sha(Path('/source')/Path(p).name)==h
v=json.loads(Path('/source/check.json').read_text());assert v==r['validation']
assert v['seed']==17 and v['grid']==[512,512] and v['classes']==4 and v['anchors_per_cell']==8 and v['pillars']==20000 and v['points_per_pillar']==32
assert v['parameters']==4817114+(8-2)*(4+7+2)*(384+1)
assert type(v['parameter_tensors']) is int and v['parameter_tensors']>0
assert v['optimizer_state_bytes']==8*v['parameters']+4*v['parameter_tensors']
assert v['synthetic_optimizer_steps']==3 and v['first_update_analytic_check'] is True and v['tf32'] is False
assert len(v['step_seconds'])==len(v['synthetic_losses'])==3
assert all(type(x) in (int,float) and math.isfinite(x) and x>0 for x in v['step_seconds'])
assert all(math.isfinite(x) and x>=0 for x in v['synthetic_losses'])
assert v['peak_reserved_bytes']>=v['peak_allocated_bytes']>v['optimizer_state_bytes']>0 and v['peak_rss_kib']>0
Path('/outputs/check.json').write_text(json.dumps({'parameters':v['parameters'],'optimizer_state_bytes':v['optimizer_state_bytes'],'peak_allocated_bytes':v['peak_allocated_bytes'],'synthetic_steps':3,'scope':'retained resource report independently reconciled; native scientific costs and outcomes remain unverified'}));print('PASS independent retained optimizer resource audit')
